xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4755: Make dialogs rise above the page: overlay tokens, shared Modal, New conversation dialog redesign

plan.title: Make dialogs rise above the page: overlay tokens, shared Modal, New conversation dialog redesign
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Operator-approved single issue (mockup approved 2026-11-01) whose acceptance criteria span tokens, the Modal primitive, the dialog and the theme-import mapping. About 29 files across 7 path-subsystems, but code lives in three (src/dashboard, src/lib, packages/contracts); the others are docs (design/style-guide, sync-sources/dev-skills, configuration/appearance.mdx) and the CI frontend test list (scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt). Items are already decomposed into 17 small commits; splitting FR-4 into a sibling issue would leave this issue's import acceptance criterion unmet.

narratives.Problem: The New conversation dialog (NewConversationDialog.tsx, PAN-4486) is darker than the page under Broadsheet light because .dialog reads --popover (hsl(30 8% 94.5%)) over --background (hsl(0 0% 96.5%)); it has no box-shadow; imported VS Code themes set --popover from sideBar.background; and its flex rows with nowrap labels start every control at a different x while the First message field falls below the viewport.
narratives.Proposal: Add four overlay tokens (--surface-overlay, --surface-overlay-field, --border-overlay, --overlay-scrim) under the four-scope contract; add a shared, portaled Modal primitive (scrim, raised panel with --shadow-overlay, header/body/pinned/footer slots, Escape/scrim dismissal, focus in/return, Tab trap, entrance motion, bottom sheet under 600px); rebuild NewConversationDialog on it as five sections on a 124px label grid with a segmented effort control, context switches, a collapsed skills summary and a live footer summary; map VS Code quickInput.background (fallback editorWidget.background) to a new ui.overlay key that applyUiTokens applies, deriving an overlay from ui.background otherwise; document the tokens, the primitive and the mapping. Every open choice is decided in the PRD (.pan/drafts/PAN-4755.md, Decisions D1-D17).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Migrating the other ~45 bespoke dialogs onto Modal (follow-up issue)
- Changing --popover, --card, menus, popovers, tooltips or picker dropdown surfaces
- An exit animation, body scroll lock, or inert/aria-hidden on the app behind the Modal
- Arrow-key or roving-tabindex navigation in the effort radiogroup
- Changing the picker trigger focus style for other ModelSelect/HarnessSelect callers
- A committed Playwright e2e spec for the dialog (browser checks are test-role UAT)
- Stripping alpha from a hand-edited ui.overlay in a theme JSON file
- Renaming the 'New conversation with options…' entries in NewConversationSplitButton.tsx and CommandPalette.tsx
- Any .dark or [data-theme] selector in a CSS module, or any component branch on theme

autoDecisions.summary: Modal h2 and section h3 use font-weight 600; labels, option labels, buttons and segments use 500 (mockup's 620/550 dropped)
autoDecisions.rationale: NFR-2 limits weights to the Broadsheet tiers: headings 500-600, UI 400-500; 620 is display-tier only.

autoDecisions.summary: Drop the mockup's .dark-only segmented background and the #d97757 harness glyph color
autoDecisions.rationale: NFR-2 forbids theme-branched component CSS and decorative color; the checked segment uses --surface-overlay plus --shadow-sm and a 1px --border-overlay ring in every mode.

autoDecisions.summary: Modal renders through createPortal to document.body, z-index 100
autoDecisions.rationale: A primitive meant for ~45 future dialogs must cover the viewport even when its caller sits inside an overflow:hidden or transformed container.

autoDecisions.summary: Modal takes an optional onSubmit and renders the panel as a <form> when set
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the dialog's submit button in the footer slot working as type=submit without form= id plumbing.

autoDecisions.summary: Escape is a React onKeyDown on the panel (tabIndex -1), not a window listener
autoDecisions.rationale: IssuePickerField stops Escape propagation while its list is open; a React-tree handler preserves that behavior inside a portal.

autoDecisions.summary: Hand-rolled focus trap: wrap Tab/Shift+Tab at the ends, initial focus on the first body control, restore the previously focused element on unmount
autoDecisions.rationale: No focus-trap or dialog library is a dependency of the frontend; adding one for a single primitive is unwarranted.

autoDecisions.summary: dismissible={false} also disables the close button; the dialog passes dismissible={!submitting}
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches today's behavior where Close, Cancel and Escape are all inert while a create is in flight.

autoDecisions.summary: No :root/.dark rows for the overlay tokens; module CSS reads them with fallbacks (var(--surface-overlay, var(--popover)) etc.)
autoDecisions.rationale: Leaves the existing Ledger no-loss parse test untouched while still rendering a sane panel if data-theme is ever absent.

autoDecisions.summary: ModelSelect/HarnessSelect gain an optional labelId prop and the trigger reads --picker-bg/-border/-radius/-height/-font-size with today's values as fallbacks
autoDecisions.rationale: The 124px label grid needs the dialog's own label in column 1 and the overlay field look, without changing ForkModal, ModelHarnessPicker or sidebar rendering.

autoDecisions.summary: Skills summary data comes from an exported useConversationSkillGroups hook plus a pure summarizeSkills; the field stays mounted inside <div hidden> while collapsed
autoDecisions.rationale: Shares one React Query cache entry and keeps the field's existing prune-on-context-change effect running while collapsed.

autoDecisions.summary: Effort radios are plain tabbable buttons with data-default on the default level; no arrow-key handling
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the existing Inherit/On/Off radiogroup pattern in ConversationSkillsField.

autoDecisions.summary: Footer summary is one plain string joined by ' · ': raw model id, HARNESS_OPTIONS label, effort (omitted when unsupported, '…' while resolving), project key or 'No project'
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the four parts but not the unresolved/unsupported cases; a plain string keeps tests and screen readers simple.

autoDecisions.summary: VS Code import passes the overlay color through toOpaqueHex
autoDecisions.rationale: A translucent modal surface would show the page through the dialog.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue's Playwright checks become test-role UAT ACs; the token-level checks are a committed postcss parse-and-assert test
autoDecisions.rationale: happy-dom cannot compute color-mix or the cascade; a new committed browser spec would add a heavy harness for one dialog.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep FR-4 in this issue under plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of filing a sibling
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator approved the issue as one unit with an import acceptance criterion; the code spans three subsystems and the rest are docs.

autoDecisions.summary: ColorThemeImportPreview's local UI_KEYS list also gains 'overlay'
autoDecisions.rationale: Without it the import preview silently omits the new swatch.

autoDecisions.summary: Concurrent edits to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt get no DAG edge
autoDecisions.rationale: .gitattributes marks the file merge=union and the runner dedupes, so parallel additions merge cleanly.

expected_outputs: Modal.test.tsx passes all ten named tests

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 with decisions D3-D10. Implement `Modal` with the exact `ModalProps` API from the PRD (title, description, onClose, dismissible=true, onSubmit, pinned, footer, children), rendered via createPortal to document.body: scrim div (data-component="modal-scrim") → panel (form when onSubmit else div; role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby only with a description, tabIndex -1, data-component="modal") → header (h2 title, optional p description, Close button with lucide X, disabled when not dismissible) → scrolling body → optional pinned → optional footer. Escape via React onKeyDown on the panel; scrim closes only when mousedown and click both land on the scrim; initial focus = first focusable in the body (excluding [hidden] subtrees) else the panel; restore the previously focused element on unmount; Tab/Shift+Tab wrap at the ends. Use the PRD's Modal.module.css verbatim (overlay tokens with fallbacks, --shadow-overlay, 160ms/220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) entrance, prefers-reduced-motion off, bottom sheet at max-width 600px). Write the nine named tests; happy-dom only supports asserting the Tab wrap cases. Add the test path to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt.

items.title: Given a Modal with title and description, getByRole('dialog', { name: title }) returns it with aria-modal="true" and the description as its accessible description, and the dialog element is not a descendant of the render container (portaled to document.body)

When Escape is pressed, or a mousedown and click both land on [data-component="modal-scrim"], the Modal closes by calling onClose once; a click inside the panel and an Escape whose child handler stopped propagation leave it open
With dismissible={false}, Escape and scrim click do not call onClose and the Close button renders disabled
On mount focus moves to the first body control; on unmount focus returns to the previously focused trigger; Tab from the last control focuses the first and Shift+Tab from the first focuses the last

With onSubmit set the panel renders as a <form> and a type=submit footer button calls onSubmit; grep finds `box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay)` and `prefers-reduced-motion` in Modal.module.css and the test path in scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt

narrative.Action: PRD AC-14 / D16. Run the built dashboard (or Vite dev) and drive it with Playwright in an isolated browser profile (never another agent's session).
